examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 喝無糖的飲料比較健康。
examples.pinyin: Hē wú táng de yǐnliào bǐjiào jiànkāng.
examples.english: Drinking sugar-free drinks is healthier.

examples.chinese: 我的飲料不要加糖和冰塊，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yǐnliào bùyào jiā táng hé bīngkuài, xièxie.
examples.english: I don't want sugar and ice cubes added to my drink, thank you.

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
這兩件衣服都很漂亮，我不知道選哪一件比較好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu dōu hěn piàoliang, wǒ bù zhīdào xuǎn nǎ yī jiàn bǐjiào hǎo.
examples.english: Both of these two pieces of clothing are very pretty; I don't know which one is better to choose.

examples.chinese: 去KTV辦活動，是一個不錯的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Qù KTV bàn huódòng, shì yī ge bùcuò de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: Holding an event at a KTV is a pretty good choice.

examples.chinese: 你畢業後要出國留學或是留在國內工作，都是不錯的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìyè hòu yào chūguó liúxué huòshì liú zài guónèi gōngzuò, dōu shì bùcuò de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: After you graduate, whether you go abroad to study or stay in the country to work, both are good choices.

examples.chinese: 這學期我選了三門課，聽說都不輕鬆！
examples.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī wǒ xuǎnle sān mén kè, tīngshuō dōu bù qīngsōng!
examples.english: This semester I've chosen three courses; I've heard they're all not easy!

examples.chinese: 畢業後要工作還是要繼續念書，我得好好地想想再選擇！
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu yào gōngzuò háishì yào jìxù niànshū, wǒ děi hǎohǎo de xiǎngxiang zài xuǎnzé!
examples.english: After graduation, whether to work or to continue studying, I must think it over carefully before choosing!

examples.chinese: 筆電的價格和功能，都會影響顧客的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Bǐdiàn de jiàgé hé gōngnéng, dōu huì yǐngxiǎng gùkè de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The price and functions of laptops both influence customers' choices.

examples.chinese: 張教授上課的方式很活潑，所以很多學生要選他的課。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jiàoshòu shàngkè de fāngshì hěn huópō, suǒyǐ hěn duō xuésheng yào xuǎn tā de kè.
examples.english: Professor Zhang's teaching style is very lively, so many students want to take his class.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
上網買鞋子前先比一下腳的大小，才知道選哪個尺寸。
那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
A:這幾雙拖鞋我都喜歡，不知道怎麼挑選？ B:這容易，你挑雙便宜的就好。
爸爸挑選西裝時，最重視的是品質，其次才是式樣。
在臺灣，上網訂好火車票後，可選擇到車站或便利商店取票。
大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
運動選手在參加比賽前，補充營養的飲食很重要。
訓練出著名跳高選手的教練認為，要跳得高，技巧很重要。
裁判的工作是確定每位選手都遵守規定，讓比賽順利進行。

items.wordHook: A 辶(movement) of the 巽(mild) wind gently moves and selects the ripest fruit from the tree, so 選 means select.

examples.chinese: 參加團體旅遊比較不自由，可是不必自己訂旅館、訂車票。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐjiào bù zìyóu, kěshì bùbì zìjǐ dìng lǚguǎn, dìng chēpiào.
examples.english: Joining a group tour is less free, but you don't have to book hotels and tickets yourself.

examples.chinese: 我不曾一個人去旅行，總是參加團體旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù céng yí ge rén qù lǚxíng, zǒngshì cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu.
examples.english: I have never traveled alone; I always join group tours.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 從那個偶像團體的舞蹈，就可以看出他們練(to practice)舞時花了多少工夫。
在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
團體活動中，不團結就失去了合作的意義。
這次數學期末考的筆試很難，我有四題寫錯了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué qīmòkǎo de bǐshì hěn nán, wǒ yǒu sì tí xiě cuò le.
examples.english: This math final written exam was very hard; I got four questions wrong.

examples.chinese: 這次期末的筆試不太難，大家都考得不錯。今天早上考筆試的時候，我寫得太慢了，所以沒寫完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò de bǐshì bù tài nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de bùcuò. Jīntiān zǎoshang kǎo bǐshì de shíhou, wǒ xiě de tài màn le, suǒyǐ méi xiě wán.
examples.english: This final written exam is not too hard; everyone did pretty well. This morning when I took the written exam, I wrote too slowly, so I didn't finish.

examples.chinese: 教授說，期末考的筆試比較難，一定要好好地複習。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō, qīmòkǎo de bǐshì bǐjiào nán, yīdìng yào hǎohǎo de fùxí.
examples.english: The professor said the written exam for the final will be relatively difficult, so you must review well.

examples.chinese: 等我完成期末報告，就要跟同學去韓國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ wánchéng qīmò bàogào, jiù yào gēn tóngxué qù Hánguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: After I finish my final report, I will go traveling to Korea with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我過得很充實，不但完成了期末報告，還跟同學去游泳、衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí, búdàn wánchéng le qīmò bàogào, hái gēn tóngxué qù yóuyǒng, chōnglàng.
examples.english: This weekend I had a very full time—not only did I finish my final report, but I also went swimming and surfing with classmates.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 天哪！這次期末考真不容易呀，要是考不好被當了，怎麼辦哪？
我最近每天運動，體重減了兩公斤。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn měitiān yùndòng, tǐzhòng jiǎn le liǎng gōngjīn.
examples.english: I have been exercising every day recently, and I have lost two kilograms.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
如果你亂吃垃圾食品，就算按時運動，體重也很難減輕。
妳身高一百七十公分，體重六十公斤，還不到減肥的程度。
黃小姐為家人買了定期健康保險，萬一有需要時就可以減輕負擔。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gāng mǎi huílái de xiǎoshuō bǎi zài shūjià shàng. Zhǔnbèi chīfàn le, kuài diǎnr bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi hǎo!
examples.english: I placed the novel I just bought on the bookshelf. We're getting ready to eat; quickly set out the bowls and chopsticks!

examples.chinese: 我家的客廳當中擺了一套皮沙發。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de kètīng dāngzhōng bǎi le yí tào pí shāfā.
examples.english: In the middle of my living room, a leather sofa set is placed.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 呀！會議室裡怎麼擺著一個大蛋糕，是誰買的呀？
我老婆最近又忙又累，因此我特地在餐桌上頭擺了她最愛的紅玫瑰，讓她開心一下。
假如東西買回家後常擺著不用，那樣的消費就是不必要的。
室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
小王對農業很有興趣，家裡的倉庫擺滿了種田用的工具。
有一些中式餐廳的桌上會擺一壺茶，要式客人覺得菜太油，就能喝口茶，解解嘴裡油膩的味道。
我坐在公園裡看著花兒隨著風搖擺，那個樣子真是可愛極了。
王伯伯為兒子辦喜事，擺了五十桌喜酒，熱鬧極了。
辦公時他常在桌上擺一杯熱咖啡，說是咖啡香能讓精神更好。
我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
我父親的職業是大學教授，母親在郵局上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn de zhíyè shì dàxué jiàoshòu, mǔqīn zài yóujú shàngbān.
examples.english: My father's occupation is a university professor; my mother works at the post office.

examples.chinese: 沒有專業能力的人，想找到好職業是很困難的。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhuānyè nénglì de rén, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo zhíyè shì hěn kùnnán de.
examples.english: For people without professional skills, finding a good job is very difficult.

examples.chinese: 職業棒球隊在比賽時，會請專業啦啦隊來製造熱鬧氣氛。
不管大人還是小孩，大多數的人都喜歡流行的東西。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn dàrén háishì xiǎohái, dàduōshù de rén dōu xǐhuān liúxíng de dōngxi.
examples.english: No matter adults or children, most people like trendy things.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。
當你急著需要某個物品時，不管划不划算，都非買不可。
不管做任何事都應先了解情況，省得白花精神。
今天氣溫只有零下(below zero)三度，我家沒暖氣，不管穿多厚的衣服，全身還是冰冰的。
世界上再困難的問題，不管早或晚都會有聰明的人解開的。
這首古老民謠的風格很獨特，不管大人小孩都會唱。
他相當迷那位明星，因此不管穿的用的都模仿他。
一個人不管多有錢、多有地位，過世之後什麼也帶不走。
軍人接到任務時，不管多麼危險都得努力完成。
不管未婚或者已婚的人，在現實生活中都有需要面對的問題。
我覺得電腦不比手機好用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde diànnǎo bù bǐ shǒujī hǎoyòng.
examples.english: I think computers are not as useful as cell phones.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 媽媽煎了一條魚，又煮了蘿蔔湯，看起來都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Māma jiān le yī tiáo yú, yòu zhǔ le luóbo tāng, kàn qǐlái dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: Mom pan-fried a fish and also cooked radish soup; they both look delicious.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒu zuìxīn de diànnǎo shèbèi, tígōng xuéshēng hěn hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.
examples.english: This university has the latest computer equipment, providing students with a very good learning environment.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips.

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
這家民宿提供西式、中式兩種早餐，既豐富又好吃。
如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
對科學家或藝術家來說，提供他們一個不受限制的工作環境是很重要的。
自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。

items.wordHook: Combining 提(carry) and 供(supply): 提供 means provide.

examples.chinese: 公司的生產部門這個月規劃了員工旅遊，有三個不同地點讓大家選擇。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de shēngchǎn bùmén zhège yuè guīhuà le yuángōng lǚyóu, yǒu sān ge bùtóng dìdiǎn ràng dàjiā xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The company's production department planned an employee trip this month, with three different locations for everyone to choose from.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 我們公司的大型宴會活動，一向是宣傳部門負責處理的。
在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 總統在廣場點燃煙火，跟民眾一起慶祝新年。

items.wordHook: Combining 煙(smoke) and 火(fire): 煙火 means fireworks.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 這個題目怪難的，連老師都要想很久。
老師問的題目太難，大家只好望著老師，看老師怎麼回答。
大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 張小姐的個性活潑大方，難怪有很多朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě de gèxìng huópō dàfāng, nánguài yǒu hěn duō péngyou.
examples.english: Miss Zhang's personality is lively and generous; no wonder she has many friends.

examples.chinese: 這個麵包的名字叫「髒髒包」，聽起來怪怪的，可是吃起來很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège miànbāo de míngzi jiào "zāngzāngbāo", tīng qǐlái guàiguài de, kěshì chī qǐlái hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This bread is called "dirty bread"; it sounds strange, but it tastes delicious.

examples.chinese: 任何人跟他說話，他都不聽，怎麼這麼奇怪？
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén gēn tā shuōhuà, tā dōu bù tīng, zěnme zhème qíguài?
examples.english: No matter who talks to him, he doesn't listen—how can he be so strange?

examples.chinese: 我聽見樓下有奇怪的聲音，是不是有小偷啊？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn, shìbushì yǒu xiǎotōu a?
examples.english: I hear a strange sound downstairs—is there a thief?

examples.chinese: 「年」是一隻極可怕、會吃人的怪獸，也就是「年獸」。
examples.pinyin: “Nián” shì yì zhī jí kěpà, huì chī rén de guàishòu, yě jiùshì “niánshòu”.
examples.english: 'Nian' is an extremely scary man-eating monster, also known as the 'Nian monster'.

examples.chinese: 那隻貓一直跟著我，真奇怪。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī māo yīzhí gēnzhe wǒ, zhēn qíguài.
examples.english: That cat keeps following me—how strange.

examples.chinese: 弟弟昨天夜裡兩點才睡覺，難怪早上起不來。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān yèlǐ liǎng diǎn cái shuìjiào, nánguài zǎoshang qǐ bù lái.
examples.english: My younger brother didn't go to sleep until two o'clock last night; no wonder he couldn't get up in the morning.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐的工作能力很強，難怪可以當老闆的助理。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, nánguài kěyǐ dāng lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ.
examples.english: Miss Chen's work ability is very strong; no wonder she can be the boss's assistant.

examples.chinese: 他去過德國留學，難怪會說德文。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù guò Déguó liúxué, nánguài huì shuō Dévén.
examples.english: He has studied abroad in Germany; no wonder he can speak German.

examples.chinese: 這次考試很難，可是大家的分數都不低，好奇怪！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì hěn nán, kěshì dàjiā de fēnshù dōu bù dī, hǎo qíguài!
examples.english: This exam was very hard, but everyone's scores are not low—how strange!

examples.chinese: 老師為什麼還沒來？大家都覺得很奇怪。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèishénme hái méi lái? Dàjiā dōu juéde hěn qíguài.
examples.english: Why hasn't the teacher come yet? Everyone feels it's very strange.

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 一個人做錯事多半是自己造成的，不能一做錯就怪別人。
我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
這個題目怪難的，連老師都要想很久。
花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
你別怪他老是抱怨你的開車方式，他也是怕你撞著了人。

items.wordHook: a 忄(heart) kneels at a 圣(holy) shrine → 怪(unusual).

examples.chinese: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.
examples.english: Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition.

items.wordHook: When the bright 日(sun) disappears and only faint 音(sound) echoes across the black night → 暗(dark).

examples.chinese: 奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
現在去醫院拿藥，藥袋上都會把藥方及使用方式寫得很清楚。
開車時千萬別把頭探出車窗外，以免發生危險。
你既然把工廠交給他，就得放手讓他去管理。
他做運動時手甩得太用力，把手錶都甩得飛出去了。
露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
自殺或許能令個人不再受到痛苦，但卻把痛苦留給了身邊的人。
小王追求祝小姐好幾年了，不過祝小姐一直只把她當好友。
我明天要把這份作業交給老師，遲了老師就不收了。
有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
吃飯的時候把筷子插在碗裡，會被臺灣人認為沒有規矩。
請你把空罐子放在袋子裡，好讓垃圾車一起回收。
上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
這些帶子是我小學的記錄，我請朋友把它存進電腦裡。
我把房間裡那條黑色繩子看成蛇，嚇了我一大跳。
想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
A:你快點把衣服換好。還不出門，就趕不上飛機嘍？ B:好啦，我知道了。
一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
警察亮出證件，叫那個正在吸毒的人乖乖把毒品交出來。
你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
他愛亂花錢，三天下來，就把一個月的生活費花光了。
註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
他把這塊長方形蛋糕分成兩塊三角形的。
想申請獎學金的話，得先影印你的證件，再把影本寄給學校。
他剛去超市買了一把刷子，想趁週末時好好把浴室刷乾淨。
你別把剛領的鈔票放在口袋裡，很容易不見的。
媽媽常一邊看做菜節目，一邊把作法抄下來。
我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。
機會來了就應該好好把握，不然就太可惜了。
我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
要是你有看電視的空，就幫我把髒衣服放到洗衣機裡吧。
到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 看電影時，如果要暫時離開座位，記得把重要物品帶在身上。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng shí, rúguǒ yào zhànshí líkāi zuòwèi, jìde bǎ zhòngyào wùpǐn dài zài shēnshang.
examples.english: When watching a movie, if you need to temporarily leave your seat, remember to carry your important belongings with you.

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.
examples.english: A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天。我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Měi nián nónglì yī yuè chū yī shì Huárén xīnnián de dì yī tiān. 2. Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ, dàn wǒ zǒngshì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le.
examples.english: 1. The first day of the first lunar month each year is the first day of the Chinese New Year. 2. My parents send me money at the beginning of every month, but I always spend it all by the middle of the month.

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cún le bànbèizi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēngyì, jiéguǒ shēngyì bù chénggōng, qián dōu méi le.
examples.english: He took all the money he had saved for half his life to do business, but the business was unsuccessful, and all the money was gone.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

examples.chinese: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le. Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english: Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard. Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ kǎojuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī hòu, lǎoshī jiù bǎ zhèngquè de dá'àn gàosu dàjiā.
examples.english: After we handed the exam papers to the teacher, the teacher then told everyone the correct answers.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 王小姐失戀後，花了三年時間才把那個男的忘掉。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě shīliàn hòu, huā le sān nián shíjiān cái bǎ nàge nán de wàngdiào.
examples.english: After Ms. Wang was crossed in love, it took her three years to forget that man.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！
examples.pinyin: Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!
examples.english: Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
examples.english: Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week.

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！

items.wordHook: Repeating 僅(only) twice for emphasis: 僅僅 means only, just, merely.
Combining 參(take part in) and 考(test): 參考 means for your reference.
哥(elder brother), said twice: 哥哥(elder brother).
Combining 多(much) and 少(few) amounts: 多多少少 means more or less.
媽(mom) doubled: 媽媽 is how you call your mom.
Stepping outside the 戶(door) into the fresh 外(outside) air: 戶外 means outdoors.
Repeating 白(for nothing) twice for emphasis: 白白 means for nothing, to no purpose.
Combining 祖(ancestor) and 父(father): 祖父 means grandfather.
Gifting festive luck wrapped in lucky 紅(red) paper inside a celebratory 包(pack): 紅包 means red envelope.
a 䒑(grass top) grows on 土(earth) while a 大(big) figure poses → 美(beautiful).
謝(thank), said twice: 謝謝(thank you).
You open (開) the curtain, and the show begins (始): 開始 is 'to start'.
